title: Battle of Yongin
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Yongin", at revision 1370595876, opens: "The Battle of Yongin happened during the Japanese invasions of Korea. The battle was fought from June 5–6, 1592. Yi Gwang's force of 60,000 lost to the numerically inferior Japanese garrison of 1,600-1,900." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q16190986, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1592 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
